title: Contact

reading.body:
The World of AI prioritizes factual accuracy above all other mail, with corrections published within twenty-four hours, and maintains separate channels for data access, press inquiries, and commercial partnerships.

This separation of channels reflects the site's core function as a reference work. Corrections get their own priority track because a reference's usefulness depends entirely on accuracy. The API endpoint and consulting practice are handled separately because different audiences need different things: researchers and engineers need machine-readable data, while strategists need advisory work on governance and scaling constraints.

The disclosure rules for advertising matter because the thesis that compute, buildings, and power are the binding constraints on AI could be profitable knowledge for vendors in those sectors. By labeling everything paid and keeping verdicts separate from sponsorships, the site establishes whether a recommendation comes from data or revenue. This is the minimum requirement for a reference anyone would actually trust with infrastructure decisions.

sections.body: Two ways to reach us. For the atlas itself, corrections, data questions, press, write theworldofai@inkboxmail.com, which is the direct line to this publication. For the consulting practice, info@srjconsultingservices.com. We answer within one business day.

Use the subject line Correction and include the page URL and what is wrong. Corrections are the highest-priority mail we get. If a fact on this site is wrong, we fix it at the source and the fix publishes on the next daily run, usually within twenty-four hours.
Use the subject line API. Our public endpoints are documented at /api/. If you need a field we do not publish, ask; we would rather extend the endpoint than have you scrape the pages.

Use the subject line Press. Journalists and researchers are welcome to quote and cite this site. Every reference page carries a cite box with the URL and retrieval date. We can confirm methodology and point you to the primary sources behind any number we publish.
Use the subject line Advertising. Our rules are published in advance at Disclosure: everything paid is labeled, and no placement changes a verdict, a ranking, or a legal status.
AI governance advisory work is handled by our parent practice at srjconsultingservices.com.
